address: Dům umění města Brna, Malinovského nám. 652/2, Brno, 60200, Czechia
bio: This charming modern restaurant on the premises of the House of Arts is a cosy setting. The names of artists who, through donations, have contributed to the upkeep of the establishment are displayed on the ceiling. Wine plays an important role here, as the eye-catching floor-to-ceiling wine store suggests. As well as two tasting menus and a vegetarian set menu, there is an à la carte selection. The terrific wine list focuses on the Czech Republic, Slovenia and Hungary. They also use the Coravin wine system. Tip: Be sure to reserve, especially on weekends – they get fully booked quickly....
